pages.quiz:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these is a way of living in peace with others? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing what you have
   B. Teasing
   C. Grabbing things
   D. Cheating

2. Which of these is a service learning activity at a historic site? (1 mark)
   A. Painting graffiti
   B. Sweeping and collecting litter
   C. Selling tickets to friends
   D. Building a fire

3. Which of these is built by people, not natural? (1 mark)
   A. A plain
   B. A river
   C. A hill
   D. A dam

4. Fort Jesus is found in which town? (1 mark)
   A. Eldoret
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

5. Which of these leads prayers in a mosque? (1 mark)
   A. A nurse
   B. An imam
   C. A tailor
   D. A cook

6. What does conservation of resources mean? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring resources
   B. Selling everything at once
   C. Using resources wisely and protecting them
   D. Wasting resources

7. What happens when leaders are dishonest? (1 mark)
   A. Trust is lost and resources are wasted
   B. The community grows faster
   C. People are happier
   D. Nothing changes

8. Who helps the governor? (1 mark)
   A. The cook
   B. The driver
   C. The deputy governor
   D. The pupil

9. A candidate gives sweets for votes. What is this? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Fair campaigning
   C. Democracy
   D. Kindness

10. Which group depends on teachers? (1 mark)
   A. Only farmers
   B. Only drivers
   C. Everyone who wants to learn
   D. Only teachers

11. What raw material is used in a cement factory? (1 mark)
   A. Sugarcane
   B. Fish
   C. Milk
   D. Limestone

12. Which is the largest county in Kenya by area? (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Turkana

13. A pupil faces the rising sun in the morning. Which direction is on the pupil's right hand? (1 mark)
   A. North
   B. East
   C. West
   D. South

14. Which of these is a benefit of democracy in school? (1 mark)
   A. Only some pupils are heard
   B. Everyone has a voice
   C. Pupils are ignored
   D. Leaders are never checked

15. Where are fish processing factories found? (1 mark)
   A. In the sky
   B. On the shores of Lake Victoria
   C. In a desert without water
   D. On top of Mount Kenya

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain what jua kali workers do and why they are important. (4 marks)

17. Explain what would happen in a community if farmers stopped growing food. (4 marks)

18. Explain how a county with a big lake and a dry plain could earn a living from both. (4 marks)

19. Explain the difference between the size of a county and its population. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Sharing what you have
   Sharing shows kindness.

2. B — Sweeping and collecting litter
   Cleaning up is a way of serving and conserving.

3. D — A dam
   A dam is built by people to hold water.

4. B — Mombasa
   Fort Jesus is a fort at Mombasa.

5. B — An imam
   An imam leads prayers.

6. C — Using resources wisely and protecting them
   Conservation keeps resources for the future.

7. A — Trust is lost and resources are wasted
   Dishonesty harms the community.

8. C — The deputy governor
   The deputy governor supports the governor.

9. A — Cheating
   Buying votes is unfair.

10. C — Everyone who wants to learn
   Teachers help children learn to read and write, which everybody needs.

11. D — Limestone
   Cement is made using limestone.

12. D — Turkana
   Turkana is the largest county by land area.

13. D — South
   Facing east, south is on the right hand.

14. B — Everyone has a voice
   Democracy makes everyone heard.

15. B — On the shores of Lake Victoria
   Fish are processed near the lake where they are caught.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: They make and repair goods such as furniture and metal doors in small workshops. They give jobs, provide cheap goods, and train young people in skills.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: There would be a shortage of food. Traders would have nothing to sell. Prices would go up. People could become hungry and ill.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each consequence.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: People can fish in the lake and sell the fish. People on the dry plain can keep cattle and goats. Both bring food and income. The county can also use both for tourism.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Size is the area of land a county covers. Population is the number of people who live there. A big county can have few people.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for size, 1 mark for population, 1 mark for the difference or example.
